structured_output.title: Unclear whether cert-manager runs with the --namespace flag
structured_output.content: The fix in ev-ef5237d47ade only applies when cert-manager runs with `--namespace=<namespace>`. With that flag set, v1.18.0 limits cert-manager to that single namespace and turns off its cluster-scoped controllers. None of the 9 values keys in the environment summary sets this flag. The only namespace-related key is `global.leaderElection.namespace`, which is a different setting from the `--namespace` flag. The values dimension is only partial, and the summary doesn't show the container args of the `apps/v1 Deployment`, so I can't rule the flag out. Check the cert-manager controller Deployment args, and any extra-args settings in the Flux HelmRelease, Argo CD Application or helmfile, for `--namespace`. If it's there, check whether any cluster-scoped resources this instance relies on will stop being reconciled.
